sections.text_helper: Section 20.6.11 "TIMx auto-reload register (TIMx_ARR)(x = 16 to 17)" in chapter 20 (General-purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 620.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0xFFFF
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to the Section20.4.1: Time-base unit on page548 for more details about ARR update
and behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
